text:
sam: Quick sync — need final decisions on the gateway fallback matrix before Friday PRD freeze. Key asks: tiers, region mapping, model-variant handshake, and playback behavior on partial KV cache hits.

hema: Can we lock the default tier ordering? Proposal: P0=local-region same-model, P1=local-region quantized-compatible, P2=remote-region same-model, P3=remote-region compatible-variant (only if latency SLO met).

jordan: +1 but for Dedicated customers we should never route to remote-region variants unless explicit opt-in (security/compliance). Also: preserve model labeling for audit traces.

sam: Agreed. Add "dedicated: no remote fallback unless opt_in=true" to acceptance criteria.

lucy: Edge-case: function-calling requests where the fallback model lacks the function schema. Proposal: if schema mismatch -> attempt same-tier stitching (compatible variant). If that fails, return a structured 503 with guidance and preserve request for replay.

jordan: For playback tests, simulate 10% partial KV cache hit and assert deterministic token sequences across primary->fallback path and latency <= SLO+50ms.

qa-mike: I can add playback harness. Acceptance criteria notes: [x] deterministic tokens when fallback used, [x] no silent truncation of function outputs, [x] clear error telemetry for schema mismatch.

ops-bot: checklist created: /create-checklist gateway-fallback-playback-tests — include region-sim, dedicated-optin, retry-policy, and telemetry hooks.

sam: Also define retry/backoff: exponential backoff for remote-region attempts with jitter, max_retries=3, then escalate to next tier. Fail-open only for non-critical prompts (cfg per-route).

hema: Rollout gates: manual approval if route traffic > 5k tpm or if a customer flagged as "strict-isolation" would be affected. Add canary window 24h with granularity by customer.

lucy: I'll draft the PRD section and paste a compact matrix snippet in the doc. Snippet idea: 
```
Tier   | Region  | Variant policy         | Retry
P0     | local   | same-model             | none
P1     | local   | quantized-compatible   | 1
P2     | remote  | same-model (opt-in)    | 2
P3     | remote  | compatible-variant     | 3
```

sam: Nice. Include acceptance criteria bullets in PRD: deterministic playback, telemetry (route, model_tag, fallback_reason), audit logs for dedicated, explicit opt-in flag for remote routing, rollback playbook.

hema: Leaving a note — ensure we capture cost delta in rollout dashboard so PMs can decide tradeoffs.

lucy: Will update PRD by EOD and ping this thread with link.

sam: Perfect — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
